prompt: Identify the 10 most relevant direct competitors for AlphaTraderTV, pull their key metrics, and find keyword gaps where AlphaTraderTV can rank. For the upcoming video on monthly options income / iron condor strategy, surface the top 5 currently-ranking competitor videos and recommend a differentiation angle.
raw_output:
Direct competition for AlphaTraderTV clusters around options-income education in the 200k-1.5M sub band. Benjamin, InTheMoney, Project Finance, and tastylive define the upper boundary; SMB Capital, Joe Burgoyne, and Karsten Schaeffer fill the middle; OptionsPlay and Wealthsimple sit at the more institutional edge.

Benjamin is the closest direct competitor on tactical specificity but leans heavier into TSLA/NVDA single-name options. InTheMoney owns the 'options strategy explainer' lane with whiteboard-style breakdowns. Project Finance is the technical authority — long, dense, low CTR but very high AVD. tastylive carries institutional pedigree but skews older.

Keyword-gap analysis reveals 20 high-opportunity terms where the top 10 channels are NOT ranking strongly: 'iron condor monthly income', 'options income $1000 month', 'iron condor real P&L', 'tax-aware options strategy', 'options assignment what to do', 'rolling a losing iron condor', and similar long-tail intent queries. AlphaTraderTV's existing options-income authority is the wedge.

For the target video ('How I Made $14K Trading Options in October 2025 (Full Strategy Breakdown)'), the currently-ranking videos in the top 5 results for 'iron condor monthly income' are all either too theoretical (no real P&L) or too short (sub-6 minute explainers). The differentiation angle is: full-month real fills, named strikes, both winners AND the one losing leg, complete tax footprint at the end. No competitor combines all four.
